QuestInfo.name: Orbis Lite
QuestInfo.0: Talk to  the girl you met at #p2032001#'s house.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You met a strange girl in #p2032001#'s house. She thinks Orbis is sinking because there are too many monsters on the Cloud Terrace. The only way to stop it is to cut down both the #r#o3230200##k and #r#o4230106##k populations by #b50#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 50 Star Pixies and 50 Lunar Pixies for the girl you met at #p2032001#'s house. You delayed the fall of Orbis... but it's still at danger.\r\n

0.0: Hiya. I listened to your conversation with #p2032001#. I don't think you should bother her right now. She's meditating to find a way to save Orbis.
0.1: #p2032001# saw this in the future a long time ago, and she's been trying to stop it ever since. So far, she's stumped, but I think all that excess weight Orbis is carrying is part of the problem. Maybe you could help me with this?

yes.0: There are too many monsters swarming around Orbis! They're too heavy, they're gonna make it fall right out of the sky unless someone does something!
yes.1: Eliminate 50 monsters from the #o3230200# and #o4230106# populations to keep Orbis in the air.

no.0: Look, I'm just asking for your help to stop Orbis from falling down. Jeez, helpful much?\r\n
